In [[mathematics]], the '''Poincaré–Lelong equation''', studied by {{harvs|txt|last=Lelong|authorlink=Pierre Lelong|year=1964}}, is the [[partial differential equation]]
:<math>i\partial\overline\partial u=\rho</math>
on a [[Kähler manifold]], where ρ is a [[positive form|positive]] (1,1)-form.
